paragraphs: Pixel Academy, founded in the conviction that the game is the finest instrument of character yet devised, has the honour to confirm your admission to the incoming class, at the eleventh hour and not without astonishment on our part, as its Wildcard entrant: the last open seat of the year.

You will cross to Caldera Key by the Academy ferry, which ties up at the pier at twenty minutes to eleven on the morning of Monday, the first day of term. The island has never been impressed by anyone arriving early.

In view of the lateness of your admission you are placed in the Commons, Bungalow 7, on the south cove, which you will share with two fellow first-years. The dormitories of the Academy are ranked, as all things worth having are, and the Commons stands at the foot of the ladder. You are to begin there, as many who have since climbed it have done before you.

You are enrolled in the Competitive Play major, whose jacket is red. Your fellow students received theirs by post a month ago. Owing to the shortness of the notice, yours will be issued to you upon arrival, together with the plain grey collar of the Commons. Until then you will, we regret, be conspicuous.
Enclosed is the Academy's customary purse of one hundred and forty Smug Coins, the currency of the island and of no other place.
signature: Chancellor of Pixel Academy, Caldera Key
